description: Manual evaluation dataset for claim decomposition quality (Phase 1, Quality Gate G1)

samples.response: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
expected_claims: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
samples.notes: Single atomic fact, no decomposition needed

samples.response: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
expected_claims: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
samples.notes: Single atomic fact

samples.response: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.
expected_claims: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.
samples.notes: Single scientific fact with a number

samples.response: The human heart has four chambers.
expected_claims: The human heart has four chambers.
samples.notes: Single biology fact

samples.response: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
expected_claims: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
samples.notes: Single geography fact

samples.response: Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
expected_claims: Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
samples.notes: Single attribution fact

samples.response: The speed of light is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
expected_claims: The speed of light is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
samples.notes: Single physics constant

samples.response: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into chemical energy.
expected_claims: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into chemical energy.
samples.notes: Single process definition

samples.response: The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of Australia.
expected_claims: The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of Australia.
samples.notes: Single location fact

samples.response: Penguins are flightless birds.
expected_claims: Penguins are flightless birds.
samples.notes: Single classification fact

samples.response: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany on March 14, 1879. He developed the theory of special relativity in 1905 and the theory of general relativity in 1915.
expected_claims: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany.
Albert Einstein was born on March 14, 1879.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of special relativity.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of special relativity in 1905.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of general relativity.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of general relativity in 1915.
samples.notes: Multiple facts packed into two sentences, requires pronoun resolution

samples.response: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, Poland on November 7, 1867, and she won Nobel Prizes in both Physics and Chemistry.
expected_claims: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, Poland.
Marie Curie was born on November 7, 1867.
Marie Curie won a Nobel Prize in Physics.
Marie Curie won a Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
samples.notes: Compound sentence joined by 'and', two-domain achievement

samples.response: The Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum and was first released in 1991.
expected_claims: The Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum.
The Python programming language was first released in 1991.
samples.notes: Creator + release year compound fact

samples.response: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889, stands 330 meters tall, and was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
expected_claims: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
The Eiffel Tower stands 330 meters tall.
The Eiffel Tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
samples.notes: Three facts in a single sentence with serial commas

samples.response: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa and also designed early concepts for helicopters and tanks.
expected_claims: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
Leonardo da Vinci designed early concepts for helicopters.
Leonardo da Vinci designed early concepts for tanks.
samples.notes: List-like compound object requiring fact splitting

samples.response: The United Nations was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in New York City.
expected_claims: The United Nations was founded in 1945.
The United Nations is headquartered in New York City.
samples.notes: Founding date + location compound

samples.response: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system and has at least 95 known moons.
expected_claims: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
Jupiter has at least 95 known moons.
samples.notes: Size superlative + count fact

samples.response: The Wright brothers, Orville and Wilbur, achieved the first powered flight in 1903 near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
expected_claims: Orville Wright achieved the first powered flight in 1903.
Wilbur Wright achieved the first powered flight in 1903.
The first powered flight occurred near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
samples.notes: Appositive naming two people, requires entity expansion

samples.response: The Amazon River is the largest river by discharge volume and flows through Brazil, Peru, and Colombia.
expected_claims: The Amazon River is the largest river by discharge volume.
The Amazon River flows through Brazil.
The Amazon River flows through Peru.
The Amazon River flows through Colombia.
samples.notes: List of countries requiring per-item fact splitting

samples.response: Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion and also made significant contributions to optics and calculus.
expected_claims: Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion.
Isaac Newton made significant contributions to optics.
Isaac Newton made significant contributions to calculus.
samples.notes: Multiple contribution areas in one sentence

samples.response: I think Python is the best programming language. Python was created in 1991 by Guido van Rossum.
expected_claims: Python was created in 1991 by Guido van Rossum.
samples.notes: Opinion sentence should be filtered, factual sentence kept

samples.response: In my opinion, the new policy is unfair. The policy was implemented on January 1, 2024.
expected_claims: The policy was implemented on January 1, 2024.
samples.notes: Clear opinion marker 'in my opinion' should be excluded

samples.response: Climate change is probably the biggest challenge of our time. Global temperatures have risen by 1.1 degrees Celsius since pre-industrial times.
expected_claims: Global temperatures have risen by 1.1 degrees Celsius since pre-industrial times.
samples.notes: Hedge word 'probably' marks opinion sentence for filtering

samples.response: This movie is amazing and everyone should watch it. It was released in 2010 and grossed over $800 million worldwide.
expected_claims: It was released in 2010.
It grossed over $800 million worldwide.
samples.notes: Subjective praise sentence filtered, financial facts retained

samples.response: I believe renewable energy is the future. Solar panel costs have dropped by about 90% over the past decade.
expected_claims: Solar panel costs have dropped by about 90% over the past decade.
samples.notes: 'I believe' opinion marker filtered

samples.response: It seems like electric cars are becoming more popular. Electric vehicle sales increased by 35% in 2023.
expected_claims: Electric vehicle sales increased by 35% in 2023.
samples.notes: Hedged 'it seems' opinion vs hard statistic

samples.response: Arguably, Beethoven was the greatest composer in history. Beethoven composed nine symphonies during his lifetime.
expected_claims: Beethoven composed nine symphonies during his lifetime.
samples.notes: 'Arguably' superlative opinion filtered, count fact retained

samples.response: Personally, I find quantum mechanics fascinating. Quantum mechanics describes the behavior of matter at subatomic scales.
expected_claims: Quantum mechanics describes the behavior of matter at subatomic scales.
samples.notes: 'Personally' marker filtered

samples.response: The new smartphone is reportedly going to be a game changer. It will feature a 6.7-inch display and a 5000mAh battery.
expected_claims: It will feature a 6.7-inch display.
It will feature a 5000mAh battery.
samples.notes: 'Reportedly' hedge filtered, spec facts retained

samples.response: Maybe the stock market will crash next year. The S&P 500 fell by 19% in 2022.
expected_claims: The S&P 500 fell by 19% in 2022.
samples.notes: Speculative 'maybe' sentence filtered, historical fact retained

samples.response: In machine learning, a convolutional neural network uses convolutional layers to extract spatial features from images.
expected_claims: A convolutional neural network uses convolutional layers to extract spatial features from images.
samples.notes: Technical ML definition, single claim

samples.response: HTTP status code 404 indicates that the requested resource was not found, while status code 500 indicates an internal server error.
expected_claims: HTTP status code 404 indicates that the requested resource was not found.
HTTP status code 500 indicates an internal server error.
samples.notes: Two technical definitions joined by 'while'

samples.response: In chemistry, sodium chloride has the chemical formula NaCl and dissolves readily in water.
expected_claims: Sodium chloride has the chemical formula NaCl.
Sodium chloride dissolves readily in water.
samples.notes: Chemistry formula + property fact

samples.response: The TCP protocol guarantees ordered delivery of data packets, whereas UDP does not guarantee delivery order.
expected_claims: The TCP protocol guarantees ordered delivery of data packets.
UDP does not guarantee delivery order.
samples.notes: Networking comparison via 'whereas'

samples.response: Big-O notation describes the upper bound of an algorithm's time complexity, and O(n log n) is the complexity of efficient sorting algorithms like mergesort.
expected_claims: Big-O notation describes the upper bound of an algorithm's time complexity.
O(n log n) is the complexity of efficient sorting algorithms like mergesort.
samples.notes: CS theory definition + concrete example

samples.response: DNA consists of four nucleotide bases: adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine.
expected_claims: DNA consists of four nucleotide bases.
DNA's nucleotide bases include adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine.
samples.notes: List enumeration within a biology fact — list items may or may not be split

samples.response: REST APIs typically use HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE to perform CRUD operations.
expected_claims: REST APIs typically use HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE to perform CRUD operations.
samples.notes: Technical enumeration, likely kept as one claim due to list cohesion

samples.response: In statistics, a p-value below 0.05 is commonly used as a threshold for statistical significance.
expected_claims: In statistics, a p-value below 0.05 is commonly used as a threshold for statistical significance.
samples.notes: Statistical convention, single claim

samples.response: The CPU's clock speed is measured in gigahertz, and a higher clock speed generally allows for more instructions per second.
expected_claims: The CPU's clock speed is measured in gigahertz.
A higher clock speed generally allows for more instructions per second.
samples.notes: Hardware fact + causal relationship, joined by 'and'

samples.response: Blockchain technology uses cryptographic hashing to link blocks of data, and each block contains a hash of the previous block.
expected_claims: Blockchain technology uses cryptographic hashing to link blocks of data.
Each block contains a hash of the previous block.
samples.notes: Blockchain technical definition compound
Empty string edge case — must return empty list, not raise
Whitespace-only edge case

samples.response: Yes.
samples.notes: Single-word non-factual response — likely filtered as too short/non-factual

samples.response: Here are the top 3 programming languages: 1) Python, 2) JavaScript, 3) Java.
expected_claims: Python is one of the top 3 programming languages.
JavaScript is one of the top 3 programming languages.
Java is one of the top 3 programming languages.
samples.notes: Numbered list embedded in prose — list header may be filtered as meta-commentary

samples.response: 3.14159 is an approximation of pi.
expected_claims: 3.14159 is an approximation of pi.

expected_claims: Company revenue in Q1 was $2 million.
Company revenue in Q2 was $3.5 million.
